game_title: Code Reading Relay – Dune Crest Defense
game_concept: A tower defense set in Sand Dunes – Dune Crest, a high dune crest: the desert nomad must handle sand wyrms while practicing debugging & combined skills. Core idea – Code Reading Relay: Read short programs as a relay and predict their output line by line.
theme: Sand Dunes – Dune Crest: a high dune crest
core_gameplay_loop: In Dune Crest, repeat each round: Read short programs as a relay and predict their output line by line. Each round, sand wyrms strike the oasis, so respond before the next strike lands. Then check the predicted value and advance.
secondary_mechanics: Bonus coins for fast correct moves
player_objective: Protect the oasis from sand wyrms in Dune Crest: keep the predicted meter above zero by applying the concept correctly until the 80-second timer ends.
controls: Code-editor: type or edit short lines in the code panel and press Run; click to select targets.
lose_condition: predicted drops to 0, or lives reach 0, before the 80-second timer ends.
learning_alignment: Week 9 – Debugging & Combined Skills | Level 10 (extended tier): Code Reading Relay
assets_style: sun-baked pixel-art desert: golden dunes, tall cacti, a bright blue oasis, warm orange shadows; flat Kenney-style sprites; desert oud, hand drums and sandy wind
duplicate_check_notes: Unique combination of primary mechanic 'Code Reading Relay' (Week 9 slot 10), mission type 'Survival Siege', and setting 'Dune Crest'. region.name: Sand Dunes

tutorial: Step 1: Look at the code panel. It shows how predicted changes.
Step 2: Use the controls to apply the code idea against sand wyrms in Dune Crest.
Step 3: Win by meeting the goal: Timer reaches 80 seconds while predicted > 0.
